# weir path

<!-- Generated by `weir reference`. Do not edit: change the help text in src/main.rs and regenerate. -->

Print the path of a repository's mirror.

```text
Print the path of a repository's mirror

Usage: weir path [OPTIONS] <REPO>

Arguments:
  <REPO>
          <repo>, <owner>/<repo> or <host>/<owner>/<repo>

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
